receipt.error: AWS launch response needs inspection with the same client token: An error occurred (InsufficientInstanceCapacity) when calling the RunInstances operation (reached max retries: 2): We currently do not have sufficient g6e.2xlarge capacity in the Availability Zone you requested (us-east-1a). Our system will be working on provisioning additional capacity. You can currently get g6e.2xlarge capacity by not specifying an Availability Zone in your request or choosing us-east-1b, us-east-1c, us-east-1d.

resolution.reason: AWS identified us-east-1b capacity. Use its existing default subnet in the same VPC, security group, main route table, and network ACL.
